memories.author: D05
memories.text: Rheumatoid arthritis, presenting with symmetrical joint pain and morning stiffness lasting >1 hour. Examination shows tender and swollen MCP and PIP joints bilaterally, no deformities. No respiratory symptoms. Smoking status: never. Spirometry: FEV1 2.80 L (92% pred), FVC 3.40 L (95% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.82; unchanged from baseline. ACT score 24 (well controlled). Technique checked: N/A (no inhaler). Plan: start DMARD therapy, baseline labs, review in 8 weeks.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Methotrexate 10 mg orally once weekly
Folic acid 5 mg orally once weekly
Hydroxychloroquine 200 mg orally daily
Prednisolone 5 mg orally daily

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Rheumatoid arthritis, improved. Patient reports reduced joint pain, morning stiffness now 30 minutes. Examination: mild tenderness in wrists, no synovitis. Spirometry: FEV1 2.85 L (94% pred), FVC 3.45 L (96% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.83; change in FEV1 +0.05 L since last test. ACT score 24 (well controlled). Technique checked: N/A. Smoking status: never. Plan: taper prednisolone, continue other DMARDs.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via clinic app: 'Morning stiffness returning, especially in fingers. Feeling a bit fatigued. Wondering if methotrexate could be causing nausea? Advice please.'

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Rheumatoid arthritis, mild flare. Patient reports increased stiffness and fatigue, mild nausea on methotrexate. Examination: tender wrists and MCP joints, no swelling. Spirometry: FEV1 2.78 L (92% pred), FVC 3.38 L (94% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.82; change -0.07 L since last visit. ACT score 22 (well controlled). Technique checked: N/A. Smoking status: never. Plan: brief prednisolone boost, continue methotrexate with folic acid, consider splitting dose.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Methotrexate 10 mg orally once weekly (take with food, split dose if nausea)
Folic acid 5 mg orally once weekly
Hydroxychloroquine 200 mg orally daily
Prednisolone 5 mg orally daily for 4 weeks, then taper to 2.5 mg daily

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Chest X-ray (PA): Lung fields clear, no infiltrates, pleural effusion, or fibrosis. Cardiac silhouette within normal limits. No acute abnormality.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Referral to Rheumatology, Dr Kavita Rao, for optimisation of disease-modifying therapy in rheumatoid arthritis with recent flare. Please advise on additional DMARD or biologic consideration. Attach recent labs and imaging.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Rheumatology review: Patient continues methotrexate, hydroxychloroquine, folic acid. Add sulfasalazine 500 mg twice daily, aim to titrate to 1 g BD. Prednisolone to be tapered further. Return in 8 weeks for review.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Rheumatoid arthritis, stable on triple therapy. Patient reports minimal joint discomfort, morning stiffness <15 minutes. No nausea. Examination: no synovitis, mild tenderness in left wrist only. Spirometry: FEV1 2.82 L (93% pred), FVC 3.42 L (95% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.82; change +0.04 L since last test. ACT score 24 (well controlled). Technique checked: N/A. Smoking status: never. Plan: continue current meds, monitor LFT monthly.
